opennyai_summary.facts:
This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings against him, in FIR No.122 of 2019, on the file of Podalakur Police Station,
Sri Potti Sriramulu Nellore District.
The offences alleged are under Section 272, 273, 328 of IPC and Section 59 (I) of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006.
opennyai_summary.arguments:
Heard Sri Raja Reddy Koneti, learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.
Both the counsels agree that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
opennyai_summary.decision:
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judges of this Court.
In view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners in FIR No.122 of 2019, on the file of Podalakur Police Station, Sri Potti Sriramulu Nellore District for the offences under Section 272, 273, 328 of IPC and Section 59 (I) of Food Safety and Standard Act-2006, are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Criminal Petition shall stand closed.
